impact.text: This issue results in permanent loss of user funds.

precondition_sources.text: A user holds launched tokens during the bonding phase and thereby earns rewards from trading fees.
The user has pending rewards that should go to the user.
The Launchpad contract has no functions to recover or redistribute ERC20 tokens sent to it; pullFees() only handles ETH.

intent_sources.text: _distributeAssets must send pending rewards to the correct recipient (the user) rather than automatically to msg.sender.
